name: opulent2-document-tools-v1

pdfium.policy: The pinned release binary matches LiteParse's npm-bundled libpdfium.so byte-for-byte. Install its LICENSE and complete licenses directory, not a second binary.

pythonInstall: isolated Python 3.12 venv; exact SHA256-verified wheels; pip --no-index --no-deps --require-hashes --only-binary=:all:
aptInstall: exact root versions from the signed and InRelease-hash-pinned immutable Noble snapshot, no recommends, no removals
networkPolicy: Build-time public artifact retrieval only. Prepared CLIs reject hosted OCR, HTTP OCR servers, alternative configs, and unprepared OCR languages. Runtime adapters must retain the existing workspace, network and human-approval boundaries.

licenses.PyMuPDF: AGPL-3.0-or-later OR Artifex commercial license; bundled MuPDF has the same dual-license policy
licenses.ghostscript: AGPL-3.0-or-later; consult packaged copyright for third-party notices
licenses.poppler: GPL-2.0-or-later; consult packaged copyright for third-party notices
licenses.libreoffice: MPL-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later; consult packaged copyright for component notices
licenses.ffmpeg: GPL-2.0-or-later in Ubuntu's build; optional codecs have additional notices
licenses.sharp: Apache-2.0; upstream's bundled libvips/dependencies are used under LGPL-3.0 and other licenses listed in node_modules/@img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64/README.md. Exact native dependency versions are retained in its versions.json.
licenses.pdfium: BSD-3-Clause AND third-party notices in pdfium-licenses/LICENSE and pdfium-licenses/licenses/
licenses.policy: Retain upstream license/copyright files and notices. Inclusion is not a commercial-license grant or a legal-compliance certification. Distribution/service deployments must review copyleft obligations, especially PyMuPDF, Ghostscript and rga.
